decisions.reason: Because this substrate offer is closely related to the firm’s core glass-packaging capabilities, serves growing high-frequency and 3D-integration applications, and shows no clear negative market signal, the low-cost option value of keeping it open still outweighs abandonment.

Because this laser-structuring service was only launched in 2024, fits the firm’s stated push into newer processing technologies and higher-value semiconductor applications, and uncertainty about its payoff is still unresolved, management would keep the option alive.
